title: IST-FAM-001: predeclared candidate spectral constraints and conventional containment audit
registration_type: author-defined prospective hypothesis lock; NOT independent preregistration or blind discovery
research_scope: Bounded source-faithful audit of exactly two prior candidate constraints on oscillator-bath frequencies and weights; no post hoc additions to the confirmatory family

locked_corpus.source_revision_policy: Use the exact Git SHA/blob identities pinned in Phase 1; do not silently follow mutable main branches
locked_corpus.prior_exposure: Several original equations were inspected during earlier Monolithic research; audit is not blind. This is a newly locked targeted check, not a claim of prior-independent prediction.

ordinary_model.positive_parameters: N finite and at least 3 for hypothesis testing; b_j > 0 and omega_j > 0 for the selected three consecutive physical modes; other bath modes may have b_j >= 0
ordinary_model.comparator_C0: Positive finite discrete oscillator bath with otherwise unrestricted positive weights and frequencies
ordinary_model.comparator_C1: Conventional positive spectral measure with integral regularity sufficient to define the tested kernel and response; no claim that all arbitrary measures furnish a well-defined bath without conditions
ordinary_model.falsification_baseline: Neither H1 nor H2 follows solely from nonnegative spectral weights; either relation can be imposed within an ordinary bath and thus does not alone certify EFMW-specific physics

candidate_constraints.label: Golden-ratio frequency ladder
candidate_constraints.relation: omega_{j+1}/omega_j = phi for j in a prespecified consecutive triple, phi=(1+sqrt(5))/2
candidate_constraints.indexing_rule: A unique physical index/order and map from frozen EFMW quantities to bath-mode frequencies must be justified from frozen sources before evaluating equality; no subset cherry-picking, sorting after outcomes, or fitted conversion constants
candidate_constraints.anticipated_sources: Prior EFMW golden-ratio/Scalar-23 constructs; candidate motivation only, not established physical correspondence
candidate_constraints.pass_condition: Exhibit exact frozen-source derivation of mapped frequency values and the stated ratio, including premises, units, exclusions, and independent replayable algebra; a mere occurrence of phi does not count
candidate_constraints.failure_or_unresolved: A source-derived contradictory relation is COUNTEREXAMPLE/FAIL; completed finite audit with no qualifying derivation is NO_SOURCE_SUPPORT, not proof the broad hypothesis is false; inadequate mapping is UNRESOLVED

candidate_constraints.label: Golden-ratio spectral weight ladder
candidate_constraints.relation: b_{j+1}/b_j = phi^(-2) for the same prespecified consecutive triple used in H1
candidate_constraints.indexing_rule: Reuse the same source-justified physical indexing; strictly positive candidate b_j; no fitting exponent or adjusting bath amplitudes after source inspection
candidate_constraints.anticipated_sources: Prior EFMW golden-ratio/Scalar-23 constructs; exponent -2 is an exploratory choice frozen for this one test, not an established prediction
candidate_constraints.pass_condition: Exhibit exact source-derived amplitude/weight relation, nondefinitional proof and independent replay from pinned originals; positivity by itself is insufficient
candidate_constraints.failure_or_unresolved: A contradictory source-derived relation is COUNTEREXAMPLE/FAIL; no qualifying proof after the finite audit is NO_SOURCE_SUPPORT; unsupported index/map is UNRESOLVED

prohibited_evidence: A notational definition or freely selected bath parameter
Pattern fitting or post hoc choice of mode subset, ratio, exponent, units, mapping, or nuisance model
Golden-ratio or Scalar-23 text appearing without a derived map to bath frequencies and weights
A conventional positive spectral measure described as uniquely EFMW
A single stress configuration or unconstrained-fluid comparison used as an EFMW-specific discriminator
CI success or structural type checking used as physical validation

classification.SOURCE_PASS: Pinned source entails one complete predeclared relation with justified physical mapping, assumptions, derivation, and replay; does not mean physical novelty
classification.COUNTEREXAMPLE_FAIL: Explicit source-derived contradiction to the predeclared relation within the claimed domain
classification.NO_SOURCE_SUPPORT: Specified entire frozen-corpus audit completed with no qualifying source-faithful derivation; bounded failure to substantiate, not disproof of all possible EFMW models
classification.UNRESOLVED: Undefined map, premises, or incomplete audit prevent classification
classification.EXPLORATORY_ONLY: Other discovered constraints or alternative choices, never added to the confirmatory set
classification.PHYSICAL_DISCRIMINATION_PASS: Not available from this source audit; requires separate independent calibration and prospective model-discriminating observations

program_stop_rule: If neither H1 nor H2 receives source-faithful support, close the bounded IST-001 spectral-novelty route as NOT_ESTABLISHED_IN_FROZEN_CORPUS and do not advance it toward costly gravitational experiments on that basis; retain separate conventional memory physics as legitimate research.
review_note: Attributed Boardy comments were relayed in conversation by the program author, and must not be described as independently certified peer review.
